policy: Frozen on 2026-11-04, before any retrieval system or model was run on these cases.
Tune only on train and dev: retriever weights, candidate depth, context limits and abstention thresholds.
Score a frozen system configuration on test, and report every test run made. A change after seeing test numbers is a new configuration whose test result is no longer held out.

Both hashes are over sorted, compact JSON, so reformatting a file keeps them. Changing the content of either file needs a new dataset_version and a new manifest, and results across versions are not comparable.
The fixture is a byte-identical copy of the upstream file named above. To use a newer fixture, copy it, re-check every case, and re-freeze.

Splits are grouped by provision (one section in every version, with any source that conflicts with it), not by whole source family: the Harbour Safety Act has sections in all three splits. See DATA_CARD.md.

This manifest sits beside the data, so whoever can edit the files can re-hash them. The hashes catch accidental edits and make deliberate ones visible in review and git history; they are not a signature.
